column1: # Board regression of the cycle-2 compiler (branch compiler-validation-plan), 2026-09-05.
# Bitstream: caplifive_s12fix_5097eb166.bit (RTL 5097eb166). It carries the S-12 fix AND the R-20 fix:
#   RETRACTION 05:15 -- an earlier version of this line said "NOT the r20-fix commit 2efb3604f" from
#   git merge-base --is-ancestor; the fix is present as the cherry-pick f623c48a1 (committed 2026-08-11, "keep the
#   CAPENTER x10 clobber additive") and in the code at issue_read_operands.sv:573-580 of 5097eb166.
#   Ancestry by hash is not presence by content. R-20 is FIXED on this silicon.
#   fw_payload embeds the 65536-node DTS (marker 0x3c2d2000 present once, 0x3c3c0000 absent, one
#   FDT) -- preflight prints "unknown bitstream" for the s12fix name, the pairing was checked by hand.
#   Ladder image sha256 4a5677c73b0eedd8 (15369224 B); the SLT image is baked separately.
# r20sbx = the R-20 repro (fpga-repros/R20-stc-rs1-cursor-forward-x10) REBUILT at VA 0xb0000 as
#   a fourth draw: the frozen sbx8.dom is at 0x10000 (collides with k800, R-3). Main-checkout and
#   cycle-2 compilers build the identical image (e3b38a4429d2); it differs from the frozen one in
#   19/142 sbx_compute instructions, all outside the arms (frame immediates, and the arm-result
#   spill stc/ldc -> sd/ld, base s0 not a0). Ruled admissible by the board lane with an asymmetry:
#   0xD0000001 (R-20 live) is conclusive; 0xD0000000 on this rebuilt draw is NOT conclusive.
# Every rung is a silicon-config build (gp-captable, shrink off, no jump tables) via
#   verify-and-stage-rung.sh: QEMU-verified against its native oracle before it cost a boot.
# Control k800 first in every boot; a boot whose control fails is VOID; read no further than the
#   first failure in a boot. Result lines only, never captures.
